versions.content: The VFB trace client has to complete the RTE's Bsw Module De- scription for the hook functions implemented by it. This specifically means to provide the swServiceImplPolicy of the related BswModuleEntry , add a BswCalle- dEntity referencing the related BswModuleEntry , add MemorySection s for each memory section used by the VFB Trace client code and add a requiredArtifact for the related Memmap Header file.
